title: integration-sprint-momentum-and-escalation-notes-2027-10-04
body:
Date: 2027-10-04
Time: 10:00–10:40 PT
Attendees: Asha Patel (notes/owner), Liam O'Connor (SE), Daria Chen (ProServ PM), Marcus Rivera (SRE on-call), Eve Nakamura (Solutions Eng)

Purpose: Weekly sync to surface current customer integration momentum, blockers, and targeted escalations. Focus this week on three active on-ramps and one emergent production regression.

Customer snapshots
1) Cobalt Bank — pilot (staging -> canary)
- Progress: OAuth + token exchange working end-to-end; embedding batch job wired to dev cluster. Latency tests show 95th percentile = 220ms for small requests on dedicated pool.
- Blockers: KMS key rotation failed in 2 of 6 test runs; root cause looks like transient HSM session timeouts when performing multi-key ops.
- Mitigation: Marcus to open short-lived KMS session flag for pilot (RINF-2319). Workaround deployed to staging by 2027-10-05.
- Risk level: HIGH (security gating production cutover)

2) Meridian Learning — MVP launch next week
- Progress: Conversation flow validated, model pin to redwood-llama-2-70b-qat set. Canary prompt set shows 3% hallucination rate vs goal 1.5%.
- Blockers: Prompt regression on multi-turn math questions; appears tied to tokenization mismatch in client preprocessor.
- Mitigation: Daria to coordinate a demo with devs for repro and add preprocessor tests. Temporary fallback: route math-heavy queries to smaller deterministic reranker.
- Risk level: MEDIUM

3) Echolabs — Dedicated capacity onboarding
- Progress: Fleet allocation approved, autoscaling policy draft ready. Throughput target 1.2M infer/sec per hour (batching assumptions included).
- Blockers: Network egress rules require additional approval from customer security; slow turnaround.
- Mitigation: Eve to provide a minimal egress policy template and security checklist; propose a concierge call with Echolabs SecOps on 2027-10-06.
- Risk level: LOW

Production incident (emergent)
- Summary: Intermittent 503 errors observed for hosted-api route /v1/generate between 2027-10-03 02:30–03:15 PT. Error spike correlates with autoscaler thrash after a kernel-level GPU driver update on a subset of nodes.
- Impact: ~3.7% of requests retried, short-lived increases in tail latency. A few customer canaries tripped automated rollouts.
- Action taken: Rollback of node image initiated 2027-10-03 03:05 PT; stability restored by 03:40 PT. Marcus to lead a postmortem; initial blameless notes in linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842.
- Next steps: Freeze driver updates for critical pools until validated in staging; add automated canary tester for node-driver changes.

Decisions made
- Approve temporary HSM session flag for pilot customers (Cobalt only) until a patch is validated. Owner: Marcus. ETA: 2027-10-08.
- Accept fallback reranker for Meridian Learning for launch to meet SLA; area team to continue regression debugging post-launch. Owner: Daria.

Open action items (owner — due)
- Marcus Rivera — implement short-lived KMS session toggle and document behavior in integration playbook — 2027-10-08
- Daria Chen — schedule repro session with Meridian devs; add unit test case to ml-client repo — 2027-10-06 (JIRA: RINF-2344)
- Eve Nakamura — prep Echolabs SecOps checklist and run concierge call — 2027-10-06
- Asha Patel — coordinate release freeze policy and announce to field-eng mailing list — 2027-10-05

Metrics snapshot
- Average token throughput (last 24h, hosted): 8.3M tokens/hr
- 95th latency (production canonical route): 210ms
- Error budget burn (last 7d): 0.7% used vs SLA 0.1% allowed (alerts set to warn at 0.5%)

Risks to escalate
- HSM/KMS timeout pattern needs Secure infra attention — escalate to Security & Platform (ticket/ops runbook recommended)
- Autoscaler driver updates causing thrash — require stronger staging gate and automated canaries

Parking lot / discussion items for next week
- Investigate prefix caching behavior for multi-tenant workloads; is isolation causing cache leakage?
- Draft runbook for 'rapid model downgrade' when canaries show semantic regressions

Next sync: 2027-10-11 10:00 PT
Notes: This doc is a working sync note; please add comments inline or append follow-ups below.
